paragraphs: The project titled 'Water Level Detection Using Stm32' aims to implement a water level detection system using the STM32 Blue Pill microcontroller with an STM32F103C8T6 processor. The core framework used is arduino_stm32core, which builds upon the STM32 HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) drivers for easy integration of hardware sensors and actuators.

The project's scope focuses on water level detection using GPIO, ADC, Timers, UART, and I2C interfaces. The system is self-contained with deterministic onboard control and telemetry, ensuring reliable operation in a controlled environment.

The components and interfaces used include the STM32F103C8T6 Development Board (Blue Pill), HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor Module, 16x2 Alphanumeric LCD Display, Active Buzzer Alert Module, Red & Green Status Indicator LEDs, LM2596 DC-DC Buck Converter Step-Down Module, Onboard Indicator LED, and ST-Link V2 In-Circuit Programmer. These components are essential for the project's functionality and provide a comprehensive system for water level detection.

The project is designed to be hardware-based, with all components connected directly to the STM32 Blue Pill microcontroller. The HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor module provides non-contact water level measurement using digital trigger and echo signals. The 16x2 Alphanumeric LCD Display displays local telemetry and level information, while the Active Buzzer Alert Module alerts the user of overflow warnings. The Red & Green Status Indicator LEDs provide visual level state announcements.

The LM2596 DC-DC Buck Converter Step-Down Module provides a regulated power supply for the system, ensuring reliable operation in a controlled environment. The Onboard Indicator LED is used as a diagnostic indicator to indicate the status of the system.
